name: Decision Playground Dataset Template
description: Template format for Decision Playground. Reference this file to define custom questions (Noul, Choice, Score) and process text records.

questions.name: target_spec_met
questions.instructions: Does the process log indicate that the production lot yield and operational metrics strictly meet or exceed nominal target specs?

criteria.true: Process specifications, yield targets, and telemetry remain strictly nominal with zero lot rejection.
criteria.false: Process specifications failed, yield fell below target threshold, or lot was flagged for containment.

questions.name: excursion_anomaly_detected
questions.instructions: Did the machine or process line experience any unscheduled stoppage, thermal runaway, or pressure spike exceeding control limits?

criteria.true: An unscheduled line stoppage, machine breakdown, or out-of-control parameter spike occurred.
criteria.false: Continuous nominal flow with zero unscheduled downtime or parameter excursions.

questions.name: primary_issue_type
questions.instructions: Which defect category or operational disturbance is primarily identified in this log?

criteria.mechanical_jam: Feeder mispick, nozzle obstruction, robot gripper jam, or part misfeed.
criteria.thermal_drift: Chamber overheating, heater element degradation, or cooling loop failure.
criteria.pressure_excursion: Vacuum chamber hunting, pump foreline spike, or fluid pressure drop.
criteria.none: Nominal execution. No process non-conformance or defect mode detected.

questions.name: severity_rating
questions.instructions: Rate the overall impact of any observed disturbance on a 0 to 3 ordinal scale.
criteria: Level 0: Nominal run. Full continuous flow, zero downtime, telemetry within 3-sigma limits.
Level 1: Minor nuisance alert or transient pause cleared rapidly with zero scrap impact.
Level 2: Moderate excursion with line pause or partial lot hold requiring 100% sorting or rework.
Level 3: Critical equipment fault, severe thermal/pressure hazard, or complete lot scrap event.

records.title: Nominal Production Run #101
records.text:
OPERATIONAL RUN LOG: ASSEMBLY CELL 1
Shift: Morning (07:00 - 15:30) | Supervisor: M. Vance
Part: High-Voltage Inverter Module Rev 3.1
Batch Size: 2,500 units | Placed: 2,510 units

METROLOGY & YIELD:
- Automated Optical Inspection (AOI): 99.82%
- Final Electrical Functional Test Yield: 99.40% (Target: >= 98.50%)
- Scrap: 6 units (3 minor lead bends, 3 misaligned passives)

TELEMETRY & OPERATION:
- Unscheduled Stoppage: 0 minutes
- Chamber Temperature: 185.2C steady (Control envelope: 180C - 190C)
- Inert Gas Pressure: 4.2 bar (Spec: 4.0 - 4.5 bar)

DISPOSITION:
Lot certified conforming to QA standard. Batch released for final encapsulation.

records.title: Excursion Event Run #102
records.text:
OPERATIONAL RUN LOG: ASSEMBLY CELL 1
Shift: Evening (15:30 - 23:00) | Supervisor: D. Chen
Part: High-Voltage Inverter Module Rev 3.1
Batch Size: 2,500 units | Completed: 2,120 units

METROLOGY & YIELD:
- Final Yield: 84.8% (Target: >= 98.50% - FAILED)
- Scrap: 380 units flagged with substrate thermal discoloration

TELEMETRY & OPERATION:
- Incident: Zone 3 heater thermocouple failed open-loop at 18:22 UTC. Zone temperature surged to 238C within 90 seconds before emergency thermal interlock halted the conveyor.
- Unscheduled Downtime: 64 minutes tool stoppage for cooldown and sensor replacement.
- Root Cause: Defective PID relay contact fused in closed position.

DISPOSITION:
Lot quarantined in Hold Bay C pending engineering destructive testing.
